metrics.name: usd_per_mtok
metrics.at: blended 70/30 API price: $69 per month at 1M tokens/day over 30 days

records.quote: Q4 · 8× NVIDIA H100 (80GB) | Overhead % 20% | Utilization % 70% | API / mo $3,060 | Self-host / mo $27,962 | Break-even 405M/day | Blended 70/30 in/out. Above this volume, self-host saves money. | 1M/day $69 $27,962 API
records.note: Cost is a fixed monthly node price plus overhead. No concurrency, seats, latency or per-GPU throughput: volume is tokens/day only, and no throughput ceiling is shown for the node. Defaults read from the rendered page; the page changes with its model and config selectors. A search snippet showed 264M/day for another configuration.

records.quote: Rented GPU time ranges from about $250 a month for a small model on one RTX 4090 to about $23,000 for an 8×H100 node and $48,000 for the 8×B300 node that 2T-class models like Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max need at 4-bit, before overhead.
records.note: Same page FAQ. 8xH100 gives $3.94/GPU-h by the same formula.

metrics.name: breakeven_mtok_month
metrics.at: one always-on server vs DeepInfra at the default mix

records.quote: Published by NVIDIA (vendor-run): 2,895 output tokens per second across 100 concurrent requests, 1,000 input and 1,000 output tokens each, NVIDIA NIM 1.8.0, TP2. | 1 server x 730 hours | How busy your servers would be | One always-on server beats this API above about 5,887 million output tokens a month (at your input-to-output ratio); one server can produce about 7,609 million at the throughput used.
records.note: Closest to Working Set: it takes measured throughput at a stated concurrency and shows utilization as an output. It has no users, arrival rate, peaks or latency, and excludes ops cost. Input tokens/month 300M and output 100M are inferred by the reader from the displayed $62; the page does not state them. API price default DeepInfra $0.10 in / $0.32 out per Mtok.

workload.name: Findstack article: single user or small team, always-on A100

metrics.name: utilization_pct_real
metrics.at: author's claim of what real self-hosters run

records.quote: Break-even tokens per month = monthly GPU cost ÷ API price per token | We have used 20 tokens per second for a 70B-class model on an A100, and we have not measured it. | $16.53 per million tokens becomes $165 per million
records.note: An article, not an interactive tool (no calculator on the page). Single stream: no batching, concurrency, seats or latency. The 20 tok/s figure is far below batched serving, so its 'impossible' verdicts do not carry over to multi-user serving. Page discloses affiliate links.

metrics.at: Spheron H100 SXM5 on-demand, 04 Nov 2026 (2.5352875 on 7 Jul 2026)

records.quote: Breakeven volume (M tokens/day) = self-hosted daily cost / blended API rate | roughly 400 tokens/sec at typical concurrency | Treat $200/month as a floor, not a ceiling
records.note: Vendor-run (a GPU cloud selling the GPUs). An article with a formula, no calculator tool. Concurrency is only the phrase 'typical concurrency'; no seats or latency. Spheron's separate DeepSeek post gives crossovers of 831M/933M tokens/day (secondary, not read in full).
